categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sale of polyester textured yarns (聚酯加工絲), accounting for 100% of its business. It develops various specialized yarn products including quick-dry fibers, antibacterial fibers, UV-cut fibers, flame retardant fibers, extra fine denier filaments, recycled polyester yarns, and elastic yarns. The company also focuses on functional and differentiated polyester yarns for apparel and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced false-twist texturing technology imported from Germany to produce differentiated functional DTY yarns. It integrates automation and computer-controlled production processes, including automated warehousing and ERP systems, to improve quality and efficiency. The R&D focuses on developing specialty fibers such as ultra-fine denier, recycled yarns, elastic yarns, and environmentally friendly fibers with certifications like Oeko-Tex and GRS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international apparel brands such as Nike, Adidas, Under Armour, Puma, Decathlon, and Skechers. The products serve the fashion apparel, sportswear, outdoor leisure, and home textile markets. The company targets both domestic and overseas markets, with a strong emphasis on Southeast Asia and Korea, supplying functional and eco-friendly polyester yarns to garment manufacturers and textile mills.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Taiwan (Zhubei plant) and China (Hangzhou plant). Sales are primarily concentrated in Asia (65% of sales), including Taiwan (35%), with growing export markets in Southeast Asia, Korea, Europe, and the United States. The Hangzhou plant serves as the main production base for exports to Southeast Asia and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, specializing in the production of polyester textured yarns from petrochemical raw materials. It sources raw materials such as PTA and EG from upstream petrochemical suppliers and supplies yarns to downstream fabric manufacturers and garment producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high value-added, functional, and differentiated polyester yarns, especially ultra-fine denier, elastic, and recycled yarns. The company emphasizes automation, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability in production. It aims to expand overseas markets, particularly in Southeast Asia, and strengthen partnerships with global apparel brands. R&D focuses on eco-friendly fibers, performance enhancements, and integration of digital management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of polyester textured yarn products to textile manufacturers and apparel brands. The company operates on a production-to-order basis, focusing on product differentiation and functional yarns to command premium pricing. It also generates rental income from asset leasing of the Zhubei plant facilities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global polyester yarn market against other synthetic fiber producers in Taiwan, China, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. It positions itself as a supplier of high-quality, functional, and eco-friendly polyester yarns with strong R&D capabilities and strategic alliances with major international apparel brands. Its competitive edge lies in product innovation, environmental sustainability, and integrated production facilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.31 billion in 2023, with a net profit of NT$214.7 million, showing significant improvement over the previous year. Production volume at the Hangzhou plant increased by 26.6%, while the Zhubei plant's output declined due to asset leasing and production cessation. The company maintains a stable financial position with increasing retained earnings and capital reserves, focusing on sustainable growth through product innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers differentiated polyester yarns with specialized functionalities such as moisture-wicking, UV protection, antibacterial properties, flame retardancy, and eco-friendly recycled content. It emphasizes product quality, innovation, and environmental sustainability to meet evolving market demands. Its integration of advanced manufacturing technologies and close collaboration with global brands enables it to deliver customized, high-margin products that enhance customer competitiveness.
